purpose: Analysis-only external coordinates for Phase 7 spatial robustness

source.citation: Wu, L., Xie, J. & Kang, K. Changing weekend effects of air pollutants in Beijing under 2020 COVID-19 lockdown controls. npj Urban Sustainability 2, 23 (2022).
source.table: Table 1: Descriptions of 32 stations in Beijing

mapping_rule: Exact case-sensitive match between the 12 frozen AirSense station names and source Table 1 station names; no alias inference
coordinate_reference: WGS84-style decimal degrees as reported by the source; no transformation applied
limitations: The source table describes the monitoring network used for 2018-2020, after the AirSense 2013-2017 observation period.
The coordinates are used only for descriptive robustness analysis and are not assumed to prove that no station relocated between periods.
The source reports coordinates to three decimal places, limiting distance precision.
